_about: SELECTION STUDIO config. Change this file (and the module manifests) to re-skin the studio for another client. See TEMPLATE.md.

accents.name: PLATINUM
accents.note: No colour. The grey metal on its own.

accents.name: CHARTREUSE
accents.note: A sharp neon glow on charcoal.

chapters.title: YOUR COLOUR
chapters.lead: Pick the one accent colour for PEPTICITY. Tap USE THIS COLOUR and every live design in the studio changes to it.

chapters.title: TYPE
chapters.lead: The lettering for your headings. Each one is live, so move over it and watch it react.

chapters.title: BUTTONS
chapters.lead: {n} buttons, each with its own hover. Point at them, press them, pick the one that feels right.

chapters.title: GLASS CARDS
chapters.lead: See-through glass cards, including the newest ones. Hover, tilt and scroll them.

chapters.title: EFFECTS
chapters.lead: Spinning, scroll-to-spin, sideways scroll and more. Try each one and keep the ones that feel like you.

chapters.title: LOGO MOTION
chapters.lead: Ways your P can move: spinning coins, reveals and light. Drag or hover to play with each one.

chapters.title: BACKGROUNDS
chapters.lead: The moving ground that sits behind your pages. Move your mouse across each one.

chapters.title: ENTRANCES
chapters.lead: How your site opens, and how one page hands over to the next. Open TRY IT to watch each one big.

chapters.title: BUSINESS CARDS
chapters.lead: {n} business card designs. Tap a card to see it up close, then LOVE as many as you like and crown one.

chapters.title: LABELS
chapters.lead: {n} label designs. Tap a label to see it up close, then crown the one for your bottles.

chapters.title: BOTTLES
chapters.lead: All {n} bottles made so far. The one marked CURRENT PICK is the bottle chosen so far. LOVE any you would like more of, including that one.
chapters.fine: The round 1 and round 2 drafts had their lettering drawn by the image tool, so it isn't the exact PEPTICITY font. Judge the bottle and label, not the letters.

chapters.title: YOUR SITE
chapters.lead: Your website, your dashboard, the client side and the colours, with twelve short questions beside them. They send on their own when you finish.

chapters.title: FINISH
chapters.lead: Here is your PEPTICITY: every final pick, every love and every note. Check it, save it as a PDF, then send it to us.
